papers.evidence: 带速度约束的通用流匹配生成传输
papers.tldr: 该文针对流匹配在生成传输中需要满足特定速度约束的问题，提出亚黎曼条件流匹配，使生成路径的速度始终位于允许的水平方向。方法利用Heisenberg测地线和自由二步Carnot群中的端点方程构造路径，并给出从端点直接计算水平路径的分段可扩展算法。研究验证了该框架在受约束生成传输中的可行性，为几何约束下的流匹配提供了新工具。
papers.abstract_en: We study sub-Riemannian conditional flow matching (SRCFM) for generative transport with prescribed velocity constraints. Training uses paths between sampled source and target points whose velocities lie in the allowed horizontal directions at each state. A neural network takes time and the full state as input and predicts the coefficients of these directions, and the horizontal frame then determines the full velocity used for generation. We describe constructions based on Heisenberg geodesics and joint endpoint equations in free step-two Carnot groups. We propose a scalable piecewise algorithm that computes horizontal paths directly from their endpoints. A straight segment sets the horizontal coordinates, and a loop in those coordinates corrects the remaining vertical displacement. We verify the algorithm's endpoint accuracy to numerical precision in high-dimensional tests. Synthetic experiments illustrate approximate distribution transport along horizontal trajectories. On resized MNIST, we use the same construction to generate images from Gaussian inputs with fewer controls than pixels.
